notes: Repeatedly ran R&D several times per turn re-accessing the same top card, then burned four clicks and all credits running a remote with Bank Job for 0 credits; later ran into known Lancelot with no breaker, lost Key Master, and ignored a naked remote the turn before the Corp's winning score.

Put Corporate Sales Team in a one-ice remote that the Runner got through, then sat on 20-29 credits playing more economy (Celebrity Gift, Hedge Fund) instead of building servers; won slowly against a passive Runner.

Spent most turns repeating R&D runs on an unchanged top card while staying at 1 credit, let Atlas score from an uncontested remote, and kept 2 tags with 3 cards against Argus, so Scorched Earth flatlined them.
Solid tag-and-tempo plan: Breaking News, Hard-Hitting News and Closed Accounts kept the Runner poor, and two GFIs were scored behind ice; one Exchange of Information was played for no effect.

Good HQ pressure through Pop-up Window and a well-timed Account Siphon won the game; the final unbreakable Merlin run was a risky gamble that paid off, and Emergency Shutdown on cheap ice was a minor waste.

Spent many turns clicking for credits with a full hand and discarding, then kept putting agendas into the same remote the Runner had already broken into repeatedly, never adding ETR ice despite 20+ credits; Psychographics was played for nothing.
Sensible checks of Asa remotes, good HQ/R&D/Archives pressure and a steady economy; one costly Fairchild facecheck and a Hagen facecheck without a fracter were minor.

Ran into known, unbreakable Mother Goddess, Spiderweb and Changeling four times a turn at 0 credits for many turns, then clicked for credits up to 40 for eight turns without running or installing while the Corp scored openly, including a face-up Oaktown.

Hoarded 20+ credits clicking and discarding every turn, played Shipment from SanSan with nothing to advance, never scored a fetched Breaking News even on a Biotic Labor turn, and left a single-ice HQ flooded with agendas for the Runner to take.
Scored steadily out of an Eli-protected remote and finished with a fast-advanced Breaking News; economy ran very thin early, but the plan was coherent.
Scored Hostile Takeover and SSL efficiently, built economy with IPO and NGO, and turned a stolen SSL into a Punitive Counterstrike flatline; the stolen SSL was in a reasonably iced remote.

Won through timely remote and R&D steals, but often paid to reinstall Chameleon on turns with no run, ran repeatedly into a known Enigma with no decoder, and ended turns with an empty grip against Argus meat damage.
Played Punitive Counterstrike for 0 damage, kept R&D on a single ice against an R&D-focused Runner, rezzed Orion (15) and Chiyashi (12) into a visible Hippo, and clicked for credits while discarding.
Strong early R&D/remote pressure and sensible tag clearing, but after Cobra trashed both breakers the Runner just clicked for credits instead of digging for a rebuild while GFI was advanced to win.
Stole three Beales, but spent about fifteen turns at 0-3 credits paying Data Ward's tax, often running it unable to pay and taking tags plus ETR, with many empty Archives runs and no economy rebuild.
Rezzed non-ETR Archangels on both centrals, which left the Corp broke early and did not stop runs; agendas leaked from HQ and R&D, and a Beale in a fresh three-ice remote was broken by Mimic.

Paid to reinstall Chameleon most turns without running, then repeatedly ran into known Enigma and Meru Mati with no matching breaker installed, never stealing an agenda while the Corp scored out of its remotes.

Clicked for credits for about ten straight turns up to 48 credits, discarding each turn while holding agendas and ice in HQ behind one Lotus Field, and lost to Faust HQ/R&D runs; Nisei was also stolen from a one-ice remote.
Clean scoring sequence with Breaking News, GFI, AstroScript and GFI; it advanced over multiple turns behind a single Resistor against a rich Runner, which was risky but went unpunished.

After an early steal, clicked for credits to 51 without installing a single breaker or resource, repeated R&D runs on the same card, and let the Corp advance and score three agendas across several turns uncontested.
